name: Byron Network Services
summary: Adelaide dialup ISP (bns.com.au) founded 1994 by John Lindsay; began as an APANA node, became commercial via a Camtech (Adelaide University) link; customers folded into iiNet SA 1996.

events.details: Founded 1994 in Adelaide by John Lindsay; began as part of APANA (hobby), became commercial ISP bns.com.au with a link to the Internet via Camtech (Adelaide University); 30 modems at home, SLIP and PPP access.

By 1996 the ISP had become too big to be a hobby; customers were folded into iiNet SA (co-founded by John Lindsay, who brought his BNS customers). Some early customers/staff (e.g. Kerrin Pine) went on to iiNet SA, Chariot and Internode. bns.com.au continued as John Lindsay's personal site.
ISP operation wound down; customers folded into iiNet SA.
